title: Work & School Life
grammarNotes: This is your first real dose of the subjunctive: phrases expressing desire, need, or hope about someone else's action pull the following verb into the subjunctive — 'espero que me contraten,' 'es importante que llegues puntual.'

The trigger isn't the emotion itself, it's the structure: a change of subject across 'que.' 'Espero contratar' (I hope to hire, same subject) stays infinitive; 'espero que me contraten' (I hope they hire me, different subject) needs subjunctive.
'Ojalá' always takes the subjunctive, no exceptions — it's borrowed from Arabic 'law šā' allāh' (if God wills), so it inherently carries that note of uncertain hope.

sentences.es: Espero que la entrevista salga bien, llevo semanas preparándome.
sentences.en: I hope the interview goes well, I've been preparing for weeks.

sentences.es: Es fundamental que el candidato tenga experiencia previa en el sector.
sentences.en: It's essential that the candidate have prior experience in the sector.

sentences.es: Che, ¿al final aprobaste el examen de cálculo o lo tienes que repetir?
sentences.en: Hey, did you end up passing the calculus exam or do you have to retake it?

sentences.es: Necesitamos que nos envíe su currículum actualizado antes del viernes.
sentences.en: We need you to send us your updated résumé before Friday.

sentences.es: Mi jefa quiere que terminemos el proyecto antes de fin de mes.
sentences.en: My boss wants us to finish the project before the end of the month.

sentences.es: Oye, ¿es verdad que renunciaste? No lo puedo creer.
sentences.en: Hey, is it true you quit? I can't believe it.

sentences.es: Le agradecemos su interés, pero lamentablemente el puesto ya fue cubierto.
sentences.en: We appreciate your interest, but unfortunately the position has already been filled.

sentences.es: Ojalá me den la beca, la necesito muchísimo para seguir estudiando.
sentences.en: I hope they give me the scholarship, I really need it to keep studying.

sentences.es: Es posible que haya un ascenso disponible el próximo trimestre.
sentences.en: There might be a promotion available next quarter.

sentences.es: Estimado señor Vargas, adjunto encontrará el contrato para su firma.
sentences.en: Dear Mr. Vargas, attached you will find the contract for your signature.

sentences.es: No creo que valga la pena aceptar un sueldo tan bajo.
sentences.en: I don't think it's worth accepting such a low salary.

sentences.es: Dudo que apruebe si no estudio este fin de semana.
sentences.en: I doubt I'll pass if I don't study this weekend.

sentences.es: Le recomendamos que revise bien las condiciones antes de firmar.
sentences.en: We recommend that you carefully review the terms before signing.

sentences.es: Llevamos meses sin aumento y ya es hora de hablar con el jefe.
sentences.en: We've gone months without a raise and it's time to talk to the boss.

sentences.es: Es una pena que hayan cerrado esa vacante, parecía un buen puesto.
sentences.en: It's a shame they closed that opening, it seemed like a good position.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Oye, pues, o sea, ¿cómo te fue en la entrevista de ayer?
dialogue.en: Hey, well, I mean, how did yesterday's interview go for you?

dialogue.speaker: renata
dialogue.es: Uy, la verdad creo que bien, aunque, bueno, me preguntaron cosas bien difíciles.
dialogue.en: Oh, honestly I think it went well, although, well, they asked me some pretty hard things.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: ¿En serio? ¿Cómo qué, o sea, algo de experiencia?
dialogue.en: Really? Like what, I mean, something about experience?

dialogue.speaker: renata
dialogue.es: Sí, y también quieren que empiece casi de inmediato, ¿te imaginas?
dialogue.en: Yeah, and they also want me to start almost immediately, can you imagine?

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Wow, ojalá te den el puesto, o sea, te lo mereces.
dialogue.en: Wow, I hope they give you the position, I mean, you deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: renata
dialogue.es: Gracias, pues ya me avisan la próxima semana, así que a esperar.
dialogue.en: Thanks, well they'll let me know next week, so now it's just waiting.
